title.narrative: Strengthening CSO¿s Institutional and Operational Capacity to Respond to Gender Inequities and Violence -Menengage Botswana

description.narrative:
Grant awarded in response to 2 specific objectives being:

Specific Objective 1: To encourage alliances between CSOs (including grassroots women and youths organizations) to develop a more inclusive, participatory, empowered and independent Civil Society in favour of Good Governance, Climate action, and Women, Girls¿ and Youth Empowerment , child protection and Gender equality.

Specific objective 2: To develop the capacity of CSOs so that they can better lobby and advocate in favour of good governance and gender equality and Women, Girls¿ and Youth Empowerment as well as the rights of indigenous people.

The priority of this call for proposals is the promotion of broad and inclusive political and social dialogue in the Social Sector.
